{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED MEMORY: ingest/pipeline/dedupe.py — Series of Seven Dropped Row Issues (2026-03-15 to 2026-08-15)

OVERVIEW:
Seven distinct occasions of dropped rows in the dedupe stage (ingest side). All manifested the same signal (output count below input count) but had different root causes and were triggered by different input characteristics. All are reproducible by running the pipeline over overlapping day partitions. All covered by tests/ingest/test_dedupe.py. Stack: Python throughout.

OCCASION 1 [2026-03-15] — Deeply Nested Inputs
- Trigger: inputs nested beyond six levels
- Root cause: missing composite index on (tenant_id, created_at)
- Fix: added composite index and backfilled in batches
- PR #1097, branch fix/dropped-rows-1
- Outcome: 23 duplicate rows per day stopped being written

OCCASION 2 [2026-04-22] — Error Handling Regression
- Trigger: manifested after client retry
- Root cause: error swallowed by bare except clause
- Fix: narrowed exception handler to let failure propagate
- PR #2038, branch fix/dropped-rows-2
- Outcome: p99 latency fell from 1.4 s to 58 ms

OCCASION 3 [2026-06-01] — Corporate Proxy Traffic
- Trigger: traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: config loader reading wrong environment file
- Fix: made environment selection explicit, failed closed on ambiguity
- PR #2739, branch fix/dropped-rows-3
- Outcome: nightly rollup matched source counts for 41 consecutive days

OCCASION 4 [2026-06-09] — Non-ASCII Names
- Trigger: records carrying non-ASCII names
- Root cause: race condition in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded initialisation with double-checked lock
- PR #3567, branch fix/dropped-rows-4
- Outcome: error rate dropped from 3.0% to <0.01%

OCCASION 5 [2026-07-14] — High-Cardinality Tenants
- Trigger: tenants with more than ten thousand distinct keys
- Root cause: unbounded retry loop with no backoff
- Fix: capped retry attempts and added exponential backoff with jitter
- PR #5130, branch fix/dropped-rows-5
- Outcome: job completion time fell from 1 hour to 14 minutes

OCCASION 6 [2026-08-06] — Staging Read Replica
- Trigger: occurred on staging read replica only
- Root cause: cache entry never invalidated on write
- Fix: invalidated cache entry inside write transaction
- PR #5139, branch fix/dropped-rows-6
- Outcome: flaky test went from 86 failures per 100 runs to zero

OCCASION 7 [2026-08-15] — v1 SDK Clients
- Trigger: clients pinned to v1 SDK version
- Root cause: two writes never wrapped in transaction
- Fix: wrapped both writes in single transaction
- PR #7807, branch fix/dropped-rows-7
- Outcome: throughput increased 24% to 514 requests/second
- Note: same area of dedupe.py as earlier fixes; context from prior work carried over"}
